title: CG Oncology Announces Publication of Pivotal Phase 3 BOND-003 Cohort C Study Results in The Lancet Oncology
author: Cg Oncology, Inc.
description: CG Oncology announced publication of Phase 3 BOND-003 Cohort C trial results for cretostimogene grenadenorepvec in treating high-risk, BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer. The study demonstrated 75.5% complete response rates, median duration of response of 27.9 months, 89% bladder preservation at 12 months, and a favorable safety profile with no Grade 3+ adverse events.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company announced successful Phase 3 trial results with strong efficacy metrics (75.5% complete response rate), durable responses (27.9 months median), excellent safety profile (no Grade 3+ adverse events), and high bladder preservation rates. Results exceeded clinical benchmarks and support potential FDA approval and commercialization of their lead candidate.

title: CG Oncology Reports Positive First Results from CORE‑008 Cohort CX Phase 2 Trial Evaluating Intravesical Combination Therapy in High-Risk BCG-Exposed and BCG-Unresponsive Patients
author: Na
description: CG Oncology announced positive Phase 2 results from CORE-008 Cohort CX evaluating intravesical cretostimogene combined with gemcitabine in high-risk BCG-exposed and BCG-unresponsive bladder cancer patients. The trial demonstrated high complete response rates (85.7-92.3%), high-grade event-free survival of 96.0% at 3 months and 89.5% at 6 months, with a favorable safety profile and no Grade 3+ treatment-related adverse events.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company reported strong Phase 2 trial results with high complete response rates (85.7-92.3%), excellent high-grade event-free survival rates (96.0% at 3 months, 89.5% at 6 months), favorable safety profile with no Grade 3+ adverse events, and consistent efficacy across treatment arms and patient populations. Results support advancement toward Phase 3 trials and potential FDA approval.

title: Fast-Tracking the $537B Cancer Cure: How Accelerated Approvals Reshaping Oncology in 2026
author: Prnewswire
description: The oncology landscape is experiencing rapid regulatory advancement as precision medicine and genomics expand significantly. Multiple biotech companies are advancing cancer therapies toward accelerated FDA approvals in 2026, with the precision medicine market projected to grow from $138.67 billion in 2026 to $537.17 billion by 2035. Key developments include Oncolytics' pelareorep showing strong response rates in anal cancer, CG Oncology's Phase 3 trial ahead of schedule, Zentalis advancing azenosertib in ovarian cancer, ArriVent initiating a pivotal Phase 3 study for firmonertinib, and PDS Biotechnology gaining FDA alignment on trial endpoints.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Pelareorep demonstrated strong clinical efficacy with 29% objective response rate in third-line anal cancer (vs. historical 10% or less) and 30% in second-line setting. Planning registration-directed study with FDA Type C meeting in Q1 2026, positioning for potential accelerated approval in an unmet medical need indication.

Phase 3 PIVOT-006 trial completed enrollment ahead of schedule with topline data expected in first half of 2026, nearly one year ahead of original timeline. Addresses large patient population (>50,000 in US) with intermediate-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.

Azenosertib advancing with DENALI Part 2a enrollment completed, dose confirmation expected H1 2026, and Phase 3 ASPENOVA trial initiation planned for H1 2026. Strong cash position of $280.7 million provides runway into late 2027. Targeting first-in-class non-chemo oral therapy for Cyclin E1-positive platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.

First patient dosed in pivotal Phase 3 ALPACCA trial for firmonertinib in EGFR PACC mutant NSCLC. Drug has FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation and addresses underserved population of approximately 42,000 patients globally with limited treatment options.

Achieved FDA alignment on progression-free survival as primary endpoint for Phase 3 VERSATILE-003 trial following constructive Type C meeting. Amendment provides pathway to potentially accelerate regulatory submission while retaining overall survival and safety requirements.

title: CG Oncology to Present at the 44th Annual J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference
author: Not Specified
description: CG Oncology announced that its Chairman & CEO Arthur Kuan and President & COO Ambaw Bellete will present at the 44th Annual J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference on January 15, 2026. The company is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical firm developing bladder-sparing therapeutics for bladder cancer patients, with recent data showing promising efficacy rates for its lead candidate cretostimogene grenadenorepvec in non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is presenting at a major healthcare conference and has announced promising clinical data showing high efficacy rates (95.7% at 3-months, 84.6% at 6-months, 80.4% at 9-months) for its lead therapeutic candidate in high-risk bladder cancer patients, indicating progress in late-stage development.

title: CG Oncology Announces New Board Member and Board Transition
author: Cg Oncology
description: CG Oncology appointed Christina Rossi, an accomplished life sciences executive with 25 years of pharmaceutical experience, to its Board of Directors. Simultaneously, Simone Song resigned from the board, marking a leadership transition as the company prepares for potential FDA approval of its bladder cancer therapeutic.
